title: Splunk Agent Observability System Role Review
dataSources: System role assignments in the Splunk Agent Observability tenant (SaaS `agent_observability_*` roles or on-prem Admin, Manager, User, Read-only)
description: Reviews who holds each Splunk Agent Observability system role, so admin rights, which include seeing every project and editing Model Pricing, are limited to the people who need them.
value: Admins see every project and edit Model Pricing. Keeping that role small protects agent traces and keeps cost figures trustworthy.
implementation: Export the system role assignments each quarter, confirm each admin and manager with their line manager, and remove roles no longer needed. Review Splunk Agent Observability roles separately from Splunk Observability Cloud roles.
visualization: Role assignment list per review, with the decision recorded for each admin and manager.
knownFalsePositives: Break-glass admin accounts are expected; record them as exceptions with an owner.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites

A Splunk Agent Observability project for the application and one Agent Stream per environment or agent inside it. Do not create a second project for the same application: a second project splits the traces. The agent reads `SPLUNK_AO_PROJECT` and `SPLUNK_AO_AGENT_STREAM` from the environment. SaaS tenants authenticate with `SPLUNK_AO_REALM` and `SPLUNK_AO_O11Y_TOKEN`; on-prem tenants with `SPLUNK_AO_API_KEY` plus `SPLUNK_AO_CONSOLE_URL`. Install the SDK with `pip install splunk-ao` (`pip install "splunk-ao[langchain]"` for the LangChain callback).

Step 1 — Instrument the agent

No agent instrumentation change.

Step 2 — Configure in Splunk Agent Observability

A project is one application and the visibility boundary. By default only the creator and admins see it. System roles on SaaS are `agent_observability_admin`, `agent_observability_manager`, `agent_observability_user` and `agent_observability_read_only`; on-prem they are Admin, Manager, User and Read-only. These are not Splunk Observability Cloud roles. Project collaborators are owner, editor, annotator and viewer, and the API default for a new collaborator is viewer. Admins edit the Model Pricing table.

Step 3 — Validate

Only admin is documented as seeing every project. The documentation disagrees on whether a manager sees every project or only shared ones, so confirm on the tenant before relying on either. This use case was written from the Splunk Agent Observability documentation without access to a tenant, so it ships as a draft. Confirm each step in the Splunk Agent Observability console before promoting it.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Run the review each quarter and after team changes.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

A user is in Splunk Observability Cloud but not in this list: the two products have separate roles; check the user's Splunk Agent Observability role on its own.
grandmaExplanation: We regularly check who has the master keys to the assistant's records and take them back from anyone who no longer needs them.

productArtifacts.title: Quarterly system role review
productArtifacts.body:
SaaS roles: agent_observability_admin, agent_observability_manager, agent_observability_user, agent_observability_read_only
On-prem roles: Admin, Manager, User, Read-only
Check: every admin and manager is confirmed by their line manager
Remove: roles no longer needed
Note: these are not Splunk Observability Cloud roles; review them separately.
